name: The Lantern Fish Constellation Bridge
description: A bridge made of floating lantern fish connecting two mountain peaks, with the fish glowing in patterns that mirror the star constellations above, creating a pathway of light across the night sky.
prompt: Bridge composed of glowing lantern fish connecting two mountain peaks, fish illuminating in constellation patterns matching stars above, night sky filled with visible constellations, detailed fish bioluminescence, mystical mountain setting, ethereal lighting, fantasy landscape
caption: Follow the fish that remember every star's name. The path reveals itself to those who believe. 🌟🐟
